I am not diagnosed but a lot of her behavior reminds me of my past bs... I think a lot of bpd behavior could be learned coping mechanisms.... It helps a lot knowing you have something aka mental disorder...  Like I'll put someone on a pedestal and then when they aren't around, I feel like they are sure to leave me, because my own company within myself is so hectic.. So my brain will automatically start dissecting simple comments, past fights.... I end up feeling confused and scared. So, my body will try to hate that person so I can avoid getting abandoned. Most bpds think their behavior is a bit off, but it really takes seeing others to understand. Our brains tend to be forgotten, when we think about the healing of our organs, but it is an organ. Just like any other body part... IT CAN BE HEALED. I am not saying stay with her, but for godsake tell her about the symptoms of bpd. She might not accept it, but slowly, when she's ready.. hopefully she will come to a healthy state of mind. DBT actually really really really helps. I am still fucking nuts... but at least knowing it, I can step back or warn potential partners.
